lines.beaver: 요즘 너무 더워서 잠을 못 자겠어요.
lines.beaver_en: It's so hot these days I can't sleep.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum neomu deowoseo jameul mot jagesseoyo.
lines.en: It's the peak of summer heat. The heat wave keeps going.

lines.beaver_en: Is it okay to go out during the day?
lines.en: The heat wave keeps going, so rest at home during the day.

lines.beaver_en: Then when should I take a walk?
lines.en: Go out after sunset, when it gets dusky.

lines.beaver_en: How much water should I drink?
lines.learner: 삼복더위에는 목이 안 말라도 자주 마시세요.
lines.en: In peak summer, drink often even if you're not thirsty.
lines.roman: sambokdeowieneun mogi an mallado jaju masiseyo.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, isn't it going to rain?
lines.en: They say dark clouds will gather and rain will pour tomorrow.

lines.beaver_en: Really? I worry when it rains a lot.
lines.learner: 비가 억수같이 퍼부을 때는 나가지 마세요.
lines.en: Don't go out when it's pouring in buckets.
lines.roman: biga eoksugachi peobueul ttaeneun nagaji maseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will my relatives' house by the sea be okay?
lines.learner: 태풍이 오면 해일도 올 수 있으니 조심하세요.
lines.en: A typhoon can bring a storm surge too, so be careful.
lines.roman: taepungi omyeon haeildo ol su isseuni josimhaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: If summer is like this, what will winter be like?
lines.en: They say there'll be a harsh cold wave this winter.

lines.beaver: 날씨가 해마다 더 심해지는 것 같죠?
lines.beaver_en: The weather seems to get worse every year, right?
lines.beaver_roman: nalssiga haemada deo simhaejineun geot gatjyo?
lines.learner: 여름엔 폭염, 겨울엔 한파가 점점 심해져요.
lines.en: Heat waves in summer and cold waves in winter keep getting worse.
lines.roman: yeoreumen pogyeom, gyeouren hanpaga jeomjeom simhaejyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 덕분에 잘 준비할 수 있겠어요. 고마워요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks to you, I can prepare well. Thank you.
lines.beaver_roman: deokbune jal junbihal su itgesseoyo. gomawoyo.
lines.en: Not at all. Let's take a walk together after sunset.
